parameters.name: Callback
parameters.description: The callback URL. This URL is used to receive callback notifications about violations in audio.

parameters.name: CallbackTemplate
parameters.description:
The callback template. Configure the following fields:

*   **{DomainName}**: the streaming domain.
*   **{AppName}**: the name of the application to which the live stream belongs.
*   **{StreamName}**: the name of the live stream.
*   **{Timestamp}**: the time when the callback is returned. The value of this field is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
*   **{Result}**: the moderation results.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live update-live-audio-audit-notify-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --callback http://guide.aliyundoc.com/callback --callback-template domain_:_DomainName_,_app_:_AppName_,_stream_:_StreamName_,_timestamp_:_Timestamp_,_result_:_Result --region cn-hangzhou
